diagrams: ok — 2 SVGs with title, desc, figcaption and role=img; labels match the text; captions re-tagged to opened sources; Figure 2 description no longer names colours
edit: ok — L3 technical prose; owner-decision wording updated to the reference kit (ruling D1) and approved analogy extension (ruling A3); stale 'unverified' cross-references in tables and answers fixed

findings: F1-79-l2-ds: invented example "VOH >= VDD - 0.4 V at IOH = 8 mA" -> RP2350: VOH >= 2.62 V at 3.3 V for the selected drive strength (D5 §14.9.4 Table 1683)
F1-79-l2-ds: pull-up "typ 40 kOhm" (invented) -> RP2350 pull-up 32–86 kOhm at 3.3 V (D5 Table 1683)
F1-79-hardware: output stage "a few tens of ohms"; heating explanation (AoE) -> removed; output voltage falls with current (RP2350 Figure 154); limits per pin and for totals (D5 §14.9.4.1; D6 §3.3)
F1-79-l3-pull: floating CMOS input draws extra current, reads random values -> TI: floating-input problem inherent in CMOS inputs; hold unused inputs (D6 §3.5, §4.1)
F1-79-l3-pull: unused pins "typically analog or outputs" -> follow the vendor; RP2350 can disable the input buffer of unused pads (D5 §9.6)
F1-79-l3-totals: group/total current limits (generic) -> RP2350 total IOVDD and IOVSS currents 100 mA each; TI VCC/GND continuous current (D5 §14.9.4; D6 §3.3)
F1-79-l3-totals: FT pins "often marked FT" -> RP2350 FT pins 5.5 V at 3.3 V supply, standard pins IOVDD + 0.5 V (D5 Table 1680)
F1-79-hardware: decoupling: supply wiring inductance explanation -> softened to the RP2350 decoupling guidance; inductance explanation in the unverified box (D5 §6.1)
F1-79-jargon: reference designator prefixes D, SW, J as a standard -> KiCad lists R, C, U; D, SW, J marked as the course's netlist convention (D8 §Reference Designators)
F1-79-pictures: Figure 2 description named colours (red/green/blue) not matching the theme classes -> description uses outer/narrower/innermost band (accessibility (guide 13.6))
unverified: F1-79-l3-pull: board revision ID resistors/EEPROM, decoupling inductance explanation, LED forward voltage vs colour, STM32 per-pin ratings, FT marking and unused-pin advice
